title: Take the mutations out of a todo reducer
acceptanceCriteria: `added` returns the list with the new todo, and the previous state still has 2 todos
`toggled` flips `done` in the new state only, and the todo it didn't touch is still the same object
`tagged` adds the tag in the new state only — the previous todo's `tags` are unchanged
`removed` drops the todo without changing the previous state
`toggled` with an unknown id returns the very same `state` object
`selectByTitle` returns the todos A–Z and leaves `state.todos` in its original order
